messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Metering: sudden KV-prefix shadow counts spike in eu1 emitter (rule: shadow-count-delta > 5000) — paging oncall
oncall-ryan: seeing it. Investigating. metrics look like a delta wave on emitter-3
eng-metering: tagging in. pulling kafka partition offsets and emitter logs. any customer-facing flags yet?
ops-anya: SLO: delayed usage reports started ~00:12 UTC. Overflagging is triggering billing alerts for ~6 accounts
cs-lina: we have 2 customers already pinging support about unexpected charges. Adding details to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1234
eng-metering: logs: `emitter-3: commit_batch_size=5000 latency_ms=1200 errors=0` — but shadow-aggregator shows duped messages. running quick tail:
```
2026-03-19T00:12:11Z emitter-3 INFO produced 2048 msgs to kv_prefix
2026-03-19T00:12:12Z shadow-agg WARN duplicate key detected: kv_abc123
2026-03-19T00:12:13Z emitter-3 INFO produced 2050 msgs to kv_prefix
```
platform-nik: any recent deploys to emitter? deploy-bot shows no deploys in last 24h
eng-metering: no deploys. suspect consumer group rebalancing + stale offsets + retry amplification. starting a consumer reset to latest as quick mitigation
oncall-ryan: do it but hold billing emitter (pause shadow write) — want to avoid firing more overflags. How to pause?
eng-metering: command: `./emitter_ctl pause --env=eu1 --component=shadow-aggregator` — doing now
incident-bot: action recorded: shadow-aggregator paused by eng-metering at 00:20 UTC
ops-anya: paused. also disabling overflag webhook for billing-alerts in eu1 for 15m: `billing-webhook disable --scope=eu1`
cs-lina: notified affected customers to hold charges, sending template message. will update support ticket.
eng-metering: ran `kafka-consumer reset --group=shadow-agg-eu1 --to-latest` — offsets advanced, tailing now. monitoring token counts.
oncall-ryan: how's reconciliation? start a light recon job? we need to know real delta
eng-metering: kicking recon job: `recon/quick-recount --window=5m --prefix=kv_ --output=tmp/recon_1812345988.json`
ops-anya: started job, ETA ~4m. Meanwhile I enabled short-term rate cap fudge on billing UI to prevent customer-facing overages: `ratecap:fudge=+10%`
incident-bot: recon job complete: reconciled delta reduced to near-zero, root cause: consumer duplicate processing due to transient partition leader flaps. No permanent overcharge detected so far.
oncall-ryan: great. steps: 1) keep shadow paused 2) re-enable webhook 3) run full backfill for any real gaps 4) postmortem. Anyone object?
platform-nik: +1. I'll open a remediation PR to harden consumer group backoff and add monitoring for partition flaps.
cs-lina: support note sent, customers confirmed charges rolled back where needed. closing customer-facing loop.
eng-metering: re-enabling shadow-aggregator in 2m with a dry-run validation flag. will watch token deltas closely.
incident-bot: shadow-aggregator resumed by eng-metering at 00:34 UTC; validation dry-run passed; monitoring green.
oncall-ryan: demobilize if no regressions in 30m. create incident doc for postmortem and link runbooks. thanks all :thumbsup:
eng-metering: creating postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/1812345988-recon-draft
cs-lina: adding customer communication to the doc. marking support ticket ENG-1234 as resolved after confirmation.
